title: Daylight
subtitle: Calendar-first redesign · LIGHT theme
best_for: Clubs that meet on a schedule; users who want their week, not a feed — and a calm light UI
differentiator: The only LIGHT skin. Calendar/agenda model. Same layout looks full at one club/one game and rich at ten — no empty modules, ever.
recommendation: Pick this for the broadest audience and the strongest new-member retention; it never dumps an empty grid on anyone.
